name: Glitz
display_fullname: Mission Maker Attacks Pyrotechnic Control Glitz
display_help: With a single gesture, you conjure pyrotechnic missiles to assault two locations at once. Enemies near the target you have selected will be bombared with miniature missiles and Stunned. Meanwhile, enemies near the location of have selected on the ground will be hit by shrill noisemaking rocket and become Terrified.
display_short_help: Ranged (AoE), Foe Stun, Foe Terrorize, Minor DMG (Fire, Energy)
